source_caption:
The protagonist, Jirô Horikoshi, is a fictional character inspired by a combination of the real lives of Tatsuo Hori, who wrote the short story of the same name, and Jiro Horikoshi, the designer of the Zero fighter aircraft. The title is derived from Hori’s translation of a quote from Paul Valéry’s poem “Le cimetière main.”

After the first screening of the film, director Hayao Miyazaki said it was the first time he ever cried during the screening of his own movie.
-
🎥: The Wind Rises(2013)
Dir. Hayao Miyazaki
